description:
Find award recipients (companies, universities, governments) by name or UEI. Returns
    each registration's UEI, parent, listed-company ticker (if matched) and its OWN obligations
    across loaded years, largest first. A parent's money sits on its units, so a parent UEI's own
    obligations can be small or negative: for a company's total use run_plan with a company
    filter (name or ticker). A UEI that is a parent also returns parent_rollup (its units).

query.description: A company or recipient name, or a 12-character UEI, e.g. "booz allen" or "ZFN2JJXBLZT3".
query.title: Query
